title: Penthouse Magazine March 1991 Confronting Bush Jesse Jackson Belafonte
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos of the front and back covers for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Penthouse Magazine, March 1991. The International Magazine for Men.

Features:
- Exclusive: inside an Arab terror gang
- Confronting Bush: outspoken interviews with Jesse Jackson, Arthur Ashe, Harry Belafonte and other black leaders
- Trump's latest fantasy?
- Power Games; a new guide to digital diversion
- Military medicine: desperately needing life support
